---
title: "Bekasi Mir Hasan Mir"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Other"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

1
Bekasi Ka Sheh Ki Charcha Reh Gaya.
Mujrai Mehman Pyasa Reh Gaya.
Sab Hoye Serab Tujh Se Aye Furat.
Qafila Yasrab Ka Pyasa Reh Gaya.

2
Zohar Tak Sab Foaj Pohanchi Khuld Mein.
Sahib-e-Lashkar Akela Reh Gaya.
Iss Qadar Tha Khushk Hazrat Ka Galla.
Khanjar-e-Qatil Bhi Pyasa Reh Gaya.

3
Dagmaga Kar Jab Girey Ghorey Se Shah.
Kanp Kar Arsh-e-Mualla Reh Gaya.
Kehti Thi Maa Soye Asghar Qabar Mein.
Haye Khali Unn Ka Jhola Reh Gaya.

4
Zakhm Khatay Hi Jo Akbar Gir Paray.
Chid Ke Barchi Mein Kaleja Reh Gaya.
Jab Hoi Be Pardah Aoulad-e-Rasool.
Phir Jahan Mein Kis Ka Pardah Reh Gaya.

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path(\"src/data/lyrics/bekasi-mir-hasan-mir-tajpoints-77fdbaf69a6ce5150937.md\")
_, metadata, body = p.read_text().split(\"---\")
roman = metadata.split(\"romanLyrics: |-\\n\")[1]
for edition, numbers in [(roman, \"1234\"), (body, \"۱۲۳۴\")]:
    blocks = edition.strip().split(\"\\n\\n\")
    assert len(blocks) == 4
    for block, number in zip(blocks, numbers):
        lines = [line.strip() for line in block.splitlines()]
        assert lines[0] == number and len(lines) == 5 and all(lines)
assert \"noUrdu\" not in metadata and 'direction: \"rtl\"' in metadata
print(\"Both editions contain four matching four-verse stanzas.\")
PY"

Reconstructed the Urdu script in the [selected lyric](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/workspaces/e419dbc461ac492bb140ef35b3f33fa7/src/data/lyrics/bekasi-mir-hasan-mir-tajpoints-77fdbaf69a6ce5150937.md) and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that both editions have four stanzas of four verses each. Updated the titles and right-to-left direction, and removed `noUrdu`.

The spelling مجرائے is tentative. The Roman reading `Mujrai` is preserved.
